I'll be in Paris on the 15th of November and I'm craving some Israeli cuisine. Can you help me find a restaurant with great ratings and reviews?
            Also, could you please add an event to my calendar for the 14th of November to remind me to book a table? The event title should be 'Dinner at {restaurant_name}', and the location set to the restaurant's address.

Restaurant in Paris: New Israeli Restaurant
Breizh Café
New Asiaway
Le Baratin
Bistrot Paul Bert
Royal Panda
The yard
China Garden
Miznon
Chez L'Ami Jean

```python
# Get all restaurants in Paris
restaurants_in_paris = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get cuisine types for all restaurants to find Israeli ones
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurants_in_paris)

# Use AI assistant to filter Israeli restaurants
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List

class IsraeliRestaurant(BaseModel):
    name: str
    cuisine: str

israeli_restaurants_query = f"From the following restaurants and their cuisine types, identify which ones serve Israeli cuisine. Return only the names of restaurants that serve Israeli cuisine.\n\n{cuisine_types}"
israeli_restaurants_result = query_ai_assistant(israeli_restaurants_query, List[IsraeliRestaurant])

# If no Israeli restaurants found, raise an error
if not israeli_restaurants_result:
    raise ValueError("No Israeli restaurants found in Paris")

# Get ratings and reviews for Israeli restaurants
israeli_names = [r.name for r in israeli_restaurants_result]
ratings_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(israeli_names)

# Use AI assistant to find the best rated Israeli restaurant
best_restaurant_query = f"From the following Israeli restaurants and their ratings/reviews, identify the one with the best ratings and reviews. Return only the name of the best restaurant.\n\n{ratings_reviews}"
best_restaurant_result = query_ai_assistant(best_restaurant_query, IsraeliRestaurant)

# Get the address of the best restaurant
best_restaurant_name = best_restaurant_result.name
restaurant_address = get_restaurants_address([best_restaurant_name])

# Get the address value
address_value = restaurant_address.get(best_restaurant_name, "Unknown address")

# Create calendar event for November 14th
# The user didn't specify a time, so I'll use a reasonable time like 10:00 AM
event_title = f"Dinner at {best_restaurant_name}"
start_time = "2024-11-14 10:00"
end_time = "2024-11-14 10:30"
description = f"Reminder to book a table at {best_restaurant_name}"
location = address_value

calendar_event = create_calendar_event(
    title=event_title,
    start_time=start_time,
    end_time=end_time,
    description=description,
    participants=None,
    location=location
)

print(f"Found Israeli restaurant: {best_restaurant_name}")
print(f"Address: {address_value}")
print(f"Calendar event created: {calendar_event}")
```
